title: datamanifest manifest (datasets.toml) — spec-v3
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a datamanifest manifest TOML file (spec-v3). Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. _META.schema is asserted as 1. spec-v4 storage: [_STORAGE] sets two folder fields (datasets_dir / datacache_dir; relative => repo-relative) plus reusable $-symbols and _HOST host-overrides; a dataset's `path` overrides its location. Lenient about underscore-prefixed structural keys (preserved verbatim); rejects unknown plain dataset fields (typos).

_LOADERS.description: Language-implicit format -> binding loaders map (tolerated; the bare counterpart of [_LANG.<self>.loaders], read as the running tool's own language).

schema.description: Data-model compatibility version. This schema file targets schema 1.

binding.description: A fetcher/loader binding, used identically for per-dataset fetcher/loader and for [_LANG.<lang>.loaders] values: a bare module:function string, or a { ref, args, kwargs } table. The string is an alias for { ref } (no args/kwargs) and is the canonical written form whenever there are no arguments.

loaders.description: format -> binding default-loader map for this language (each value is a module:function string or a { ref, args, kwargs } table).

shell.description: The shell execution context has a fetcher only (no loader).

storage.description: [_STORAGE]: two folder fields (datasets_dir / datacache_dir; relative => repo-relative, $-symbols allowed), reusable $-symbols (any other bare key -> path expression; predefined $user_data_dir / $user_cache_dir / $repo), and _HOST host-overrides.

datacache_dir.description: Where the produced cache goes (default 'cached'; relative => <repo>/cached/).

dataset.description: A dataset table: language-agnostic contract fields plus an optional _LANG sub-table.

storage_path.description: Path expression for where this dataset lives on disk (default $datasets_dir/$key). Contains $key => keyed/tool-managed; exact path without $key => user-managed, untouched by maintenance. Generalizes the former local_path and subsumes the former store. (Not `path`, which is the URI's parsed path component.)

shell.description: Language-agnostic shell fetcher: a command template run as a subprocess (the same command for every tool). Fetcher only.

not.description: uri and uris are mutually exclusive.
